payload.outcome: Resolved 2026-09-25 (ledger review). Fixed by 13a1f2eee (PR #2994): entry-store.ts no longer writes personal rows or anything mayContainOnCallCompliance flags to localStorage, keeps them in session memory only, and applies a 7-day expiry. The privacy impact assessment line that still says compliance rows are cached in localStorage is carried into #5Z3CDC.
